body.name: Published OVS-complete efficient cross-fitted estimator
body.construction:
For each training complement of \(I_\ell\), estimate all globally OVS-retained propensities and one-step regressions by \(\widehat p^{-\ell}\) and \(\widehat m^{-\ell}\), clipped to the overlap interval, and form
\[
\widehat S_i^{\mathrm{OVS},-\ell}=S^{\mathrm{OVS}}(O_i;\widehat\eta^{-\ell}),
\qquad \widehat\eta^{-\ell}=(\widehat p^{-\ell},\widehat m^{-\ell}).
\]
Using training-cell averages, form
\[
\widehat K_{\mathrm{OVS}}^{-\ell}(x)
=\widehat E_{-\ell}[\widehat S^{\mathrm{OVS},-\ell}
\widehat S^{\mathrm{OVS},-\ell\prime}\mid X=x],
\qquad
\widehat r_{\mathrm{OVS}}^{-\ell}(x)
=\widehat E_{-\ell}[\widehat S^{\mathrm{OVS},-\ell}\widehat\psi^{0,-\ell}\mid X=x],
\]
where \(\widehat\psi^{0,-\ell}\) uses the denominator-corrected reference scores and training-sample preliminary ratios.  Retain eigenvalues of \(\widehat K_{\mathrm{OVS}}^{-\ell}(x)\) exceeding \(\tau_n\), use the Moore--Penrose inverse of the retained part, and set
\[
\widehat\alpha_{\mathrm{OVS}}^{-\ell}(x)
=\{\widehat K_{\mathrm{OVS},\tau}^{-\ell}(x)\}^{\dagger}
\widehat r_{\mathrm{OVS}}^{-\ell}(x).
\]
For each target block, form the cross-fitted bracket numerator \(\widehat B_{i,k,c_0(k)}^{-\ell}\), but divide its final sample average by the global empirical share
\(\widehat\pi_{g,1}=n^{-1}\sum_i\mathbf 1\{G_i=g,S_i=1\}\).  Equivalently, write the resulting raw ratio pseudo-outcome as \(\widehat R_{i,k,c_0(k)}\).  Return
\[
\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{eff}}
=\frac1n\sum_{\ell=1}^L\sum_{i\in I_\ell}
\left\{\sum_{k\in\mathcal K}\omega_k\widehat R_{i,k,c_0(k)}
-\widehat\alpha_{\mathrm{OVS}}^{-\ell}(X_i)'
\widehat S_i^{\mathrm{OVS},-\ell}\right\}.
\]
Let \(\widehat\theta_k=n^{-1}\sum_i\widehat R_{i,k,c_0(k)}\).  For \(i\in I_\ell\), define
\[
\widehat\phi_i=
\sum_{k=(g,t)\in\mathcal K}\omega_k
\left\{\widehat R_{i,k,c_0(k)}
-\widehat\theta_k\frac{\mathbf 1\{G_i=g,S_i=1\}}{\widehat\pi_{g,1}}\right\}
-\widehat\alpha_{\mathrm{OVS}}^{-\ell}(X_i)'
\widehat S_i^{\mathrm{OVS},-\ell},
\]
\[
\widehat V_{\mathrm{eff}}=\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^n
(\widehat\phi_i-\overline{\widehat\phi})^2,
\qquad
\overline{\widehat\phi}=\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^n\widehat\phi_i,
\]
and report \(\mathrm{CI}_{1-\alpha}\).
